verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs say it supports variable recurring payments collected without re-authorising each time, plus periodic (standing order) and scheduled payments via the Payments API. Periodic payments require the direct API because Hosted pages do not yet support them. Missing for 10: in-depth VRP documentation (consent parameters, limits, sweeping vs commercial VRP flows), endpoint-level reference for recurring or periodic payment consents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
